description: NaSr₃NdTi₅O₁₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅42m space group. Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to twelve O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.56-2.99 Å. There are four inequivalent Sr sites. In the first Sr site, Sr is bonded to twelve O atoms to form distorted SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with eight SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with five SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.62-3.05 Å. In the second Sr site, Sr is bonded to twelve O atoms to form SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.66-2.92 Å. In the third Sr site, Sr is bonded to twelve O atoms to form SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with eight SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with five SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.62-2.94 Å. In the fourth Sr site, Sr is bonded to twelve O atoms to form SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.67-2.92 Å. Nd is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to twelve O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-3.09 Å. There are three inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-22°. There are two shorter (1.95 Å) and four longer (1.99 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six TiO₆ octahedra and faces with eight SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-11°. There are four shorter (1.96 Å) and two longer (1.99 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. In the third Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six TiO₆ octahedra and faces with four SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-18°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.00 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Nd, and two Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Nd, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Sr, one Nd, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Sr, one Nd, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Sr and two Ti atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OSr₄Ti₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four Sr and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four Sr and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to four Sr and two equivalent Ti atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OSr₄Ti₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
